parameters.text:
=Analyze the viral content from this week across platforms and extract repeatable patterns.

Viral LinkedIn Posts:
{{ $('Find Viral LinkedIn Posts').item.json.choices[0].message.content }}

Viral Twitter Posts:
{{ $('Find Viral Twitter Posts').item.json.choices[0].message.content }}

Top Reddit Posts:
{{ JSON.stringify($('Find Top Reddit Posts').item.json.data?.children?.slice(0,5).map(p=>({title:p.data.title,score:p.data.score,subreddit:p.data.subreddit}))) }}

Analyze and extract:
1. Hook patterns that appeared in multiple viral posts
2. Topic angles that consistently performed well
3. Format patterns (list vs story vs question vs statement)
4. Emotional triggers used
5. Posting patterns (time, day, frequency)

Return JSON:
{
  "top_hook_patterns": [{"pattern": "", "example": "", "why_it_works": ""}],
  "winning_topics": [],
  "best_formats": [],
  "emotional_triggers": [],
  "content_ideas_for_floowbox": [{"idea": "", "hook": "", "format": "", "platform": ""}],
  "weekly_insight": "one key pattern to apply this week"
}

parameters.content:
## FLOOWBOX - Viral Pattern Analyzer
Runs every Friday at 9 AM.
Perplexity finds top viral posts on LinkedIn and Twitter this week.
Reddit API fetches top posts from relevant subreddits.
GPT-4o extracts repeatable hook patterns, topic angles, and formats.
Generates ready-to-use content ideas for FLOOWBOX.
Saves to Notion + weekly briefing to Slack.
